data.description:
## Story

As a sprint orchestrator running SC-coverage checks on an epic whose stories contain `## Closure Checks` sections, the haiku/sonnet/opus coverage gate prompts correctly scope to `## Success Criteria` only — so Closure Checks items are not counted as SCs, do not inflate the coverage count, and do not produce spurious MISSING verdicts.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-haiku.md` updated with explicit instruction: "Only items under `## Success Criteria` are included in the coverage check. Stop parsing when a `## Closure Checks` section is encountered."
- DD2: `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-sonnet.md` updated with the same scoping instruction
- DD3: `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-opus.md` updated with the same scoping instruction
- DD4: Regression test (behavioral): a story ticket with both `## Success Criteria` (3 items) and `## Closure Checks` (2 items) produces a coverage count of 3 — not 5

← Satisfies: "SC (adversarial F2): sprint SC-coverage gates correctly scope to ## Success Criteria only"

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: Sprint SC-coverage gates read only ## Success Criteria so Closure Checks items are not mistakenly counted in coverage checks
